8The whole session, both ways

After turn 7 (owner): both have merit. How would B move into the exercises? Wants to see the complete logging workflow in both streams as demos; not the minute details, but designed nicely; "we'll align on some stuff later". The exercise in progress will look different from 7b's stand-in rows.

Two working phones, the same session and the same logging card; only the structure differs. To run one: tick the warm-up circles, tap an exercise to open it, tap a set's circle to log it (tap the last logged one to undo), pick how hard it was after the last set, tick the After protocols, Finish Workout.

First-pass, not reviewed, all Claude's placeholders: the logging card (sets prefilled from the plan, one tap logs a set, the set that's next has a blue ring, RPE after the last set, a PR tag on Weighted Pull-up's third set), the rest timer capsule (1:30 after each set, with Skip), the elapsed time in the header, and the finish card. Not in yet: changing a weight or reps, adding a set or an exercise, notes, supersets, leaving a workout.
